en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs on the front: the upper image shows an indoor swimming pool (long narrow hall with tiled floor, railing and large windows); the lower image depicts a school gymnasium with boys practicing gymnastics on apparatus such as a pommel horse and wall bars. Captions in Hungarian label the pool and gym and identify the institution as the Pius College in Pécs. The reverse side is an unused divided‑back postcard with Hungarian printing instructions and publisher information from Budapest, mentioning a Jesuit gymnasium, boarding school and residence.
